unresolved_added: The company task and Amazon context are not a frozen sales dataset.
Review counts are treated as sales volume without price, traffic, conversion or exposure data.
The level-1 to level-4 workflow lacks a complete lineage manifest and raw data release.
Deleting 214 unqualified items has no reproducible filter table or sensitivity analysis.
Replacing malformed characters can change sentiment tokens and affective-word counts.
Removing short words and stopwords can remove product terms or negation cues.
Lemmatization and stemming may merge words with different product meanings.
LDA topic count, initialization, coherence and stability are not reported.
Topic labels and attribute dictionaries are hand-interpreted from plots.
Monthly rating averages exclude products with fewer than two reviews without a denominator sensitivity analysis.
Exponential review growth may reflect platform age, product exposure or data collection rather than demand.
“Microwave is hard to accept early” is a hypothesis without price, placement or launch evidence.
Log review-count axes alter visual comparisons and need explicit back-transformation.
Helpful-rate plots restrict to reviews with more than ten votes, selecting a nonrepresentative subset.
Helpful votes are influenced by display position and the source itself names early-bird and winner-circle bias.
High helpfulness, length and stars are associations, not evidence that one causes another.
The weighted rating ratio gives every review a +1 vote and does not model vote exposure or time decay.
Logistic rating targets 0/.25/.5/.75/1 impose linear ordinal spacing.
Word-score estimation has no vocabulary freeze, regularization, held-out calibration or class-balance report.
The review sentiment sum ignores word order, negation scope and repeated-word dependence.
Weighted sentiment mean/std by star group can be dominated by high-vote reviews.
Preference dictionaries have 45-51 terms and may omit synonyms, jargon and unseen product features.
Attribute selection from LDA and manual observation is not independently reproducible.
The time-decay factor gamma=0.999 is not fitted or sensitivity-tested.
Rating distance from neutral plus 0.5 hard-codes extreme-rating emphasis.
Preference ratios measure expressed review attention, not population demand or willingness to pay.
The reputation contribution assumes vine/verified tags have fixed affine effects of 0.2/0.8.
Recency denominator 1/(t+1) and review-count-to-sales proportionality are unvalidated.
A fixed window average can conceal product shocks and mixes event count with calendar time.
The source text and displayed interpretation of larger m versus volatility need numerical reconciliation.
Reputation is a constructed score and has no external brand or sales benchmark.
LSTM suitability is asserted from time-series context, not demonstrated against simpler baselines.
The 200-D embedding source, training corpus and leakage controls are unspecified.
Six auxiliary features mix ordinal, binary, bounded and unbounded domains before standardization.
Standardization parameters may leak future information if computed on the full sequence.
The nested LSTM gate equations do not provide learned weights, initialization or hidden-state dimensions for both layers.
MSE alone does not establish useful trajectory or threshold accuracy.
Resampled windows from one review sequence are not independent training data.
Thirty epochs, 20 batches, learning rate 0.8 and LBFGS lack convergence and seed evidence.
Predicting 0.4 of the original review sequence is a horizon choice without uncertainty bands.
Small training/testing losses may be scale artifacts, leakage or overfit.
“Potentially successful” is assigned from increasing/stable reputation without an external threshold or business criterion.
Ripple claims from monthly peaks are temporal associations, not incitement effects.
Granger causality requires stationarity, lag selection and residual diagnostics not reported here.
The test description says to repeat across lags, but the final lag search is not fully documented.
The p-value result is not corrected for multiple products, directions or lag attempts.
Granger precedence is not structural or intervention causality.
Five sentiment ranks use thresholds derived from weighted rating means and inherit their assumptions.
Confusion matrices compare constructed ranks, not independent labels of sentiment.
Recall/precision/macro-F1 between 0.6 and 0.8 indicate imperfect alignment, not model failure or success alone.
“Water army” and differing rating standards are plausible explanations without account-level evidence.
Deviation-case inspection may be selected after observing the confusion matrix.
Mixed positive/negative word counts need a full sampling denominator and negation treatment.
Property-word explanations are qualitative and may vary by product dictionary.
Extreme ratings with mild words may be objective, but reviewer traits are not measured.
Preference-based funding advice omits cost, feasibility, safety certification and tradeoffs.
Strength claims list many models without baseline comparisons.
The conclusion calls correlations and Granger results “insights” without retaining all uncertainty qualifiers.
Price and sales data are acknowledged as missing only after strong reputation/sales claims are made.
Dictionary time limits are a real coverage weakness and no expansion protocol is provided.
The Marketing Director letter compresses conditional model outputs into confident operational advice.
Guiding early reviews can create manipulation, selective visibility or rating-governance risks.
A good brand image is not a measurable control variable in the presented models.
LSTM losses described as small enough to emphasize need scale, baseline and holdout definitions.
“All informative features” is not true when price, conversion, exposure and promotion are absent.
Product attribute ratios do not by themselves allocate a real budget.
Figure/table captions and code comments must remain outside positive human-language counts.
Appendix A/B topic figures support visual/model evidence but not author prose.
Code appendices lack a pinned environment, complete inputs, seeds and independent rerun report.
All product-success, sales, causality and strategy claims must remain conditional on the constructed index, data scope, horizon and missing validation.
